name: Southshore: an Alliance ghost released at the Hillsbrad death point lands on the ground (#7848)
contract: An Alliance player who dies in Hillsbrad Foothills near Southshore (-744.996, -539.087, 20.12) releases to graveyard 149. CoA rebuilt Southshore with a Westfall barracks at the stock graveyard's spot (-732.799, -592.502), where the stock z of 22.663 sat 1.09 yd under CoA's terrain (23.75), so the ghost spawned under the map and fell in a loop. The graveyard and its Spirit Healer now stand at the new burial ground by the tombstone monument (-639.143, -510.149, ground 33.06); the assertions bound the ghost's position to that ground and require the Spirit Healer beside it.
